basic_info.description: A price reduction and banked increases served. Income investment and historic Noe Valley property. 393-391 30th was built in the middle of the Victorian era, 1892. Leonard Haas constructed 30th Street single-family. Recently, a second structure was created behind the Victorian consisting of a two-story home with a roof deck. The homes are as much investment property as they are a valuable piece of Noe Valley history. A two-story apartment with internal and external stairs attaching the two floors. Each floor is currently rented to different tenants. The second floor has a living room, dining area, and three bedrooms with one full bathroom. The third floor has two bedrooms, storage cabinets, and a sitting room. Behind the Victorian is a new construction apartment. It also is two stories with four bedrooms and three and a half bathrooms. On the roof is a four-season deck with all-day sun.  The building generates over $85,439.52. Banked increases just given.  Don't miss out on this Victorian ​beauty with income and upside.
